title: Colors That Work
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about colors that everyone can tell apart. In the first, a plate that stings and a plate that is safe differ only by red against green, and the playable palette makes those colors look alike. In the second level, spikes look like spikes and the safe path is light and striped, so it reads in any color. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a plate.

box.tagline: Say it with more than color.
box.back: A small explorer in a pink beanie crosses two short levels. In the first, the plate that stings and the plate that is safe are told apart by red and green alone, and some players see those two colors alike. In the second, shape and brightness carry the meaning, so it reads in any color. Play, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a plate.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Play both levels with red and green made to look alike
Made to be copied and taken apart
